subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Fictitious
solution: The correct answer is 'Factual'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Fictitious is an adjective that means not real or true; imaginary or fabricated. • The meaning of the given options are as follows - • False - not according to truth or fact; incorrect (असत्‍य, ग़लत). • Factual - concerned with what is actually the case (तथ्‍यों पर आधारित). • Imaginative - having or showing creativity or inventiveness (कल्‍पना से उत्‍पन्‍न, कल्‍पनाशील). • Subjective - based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions ((तथ्‍यों के स्‍थान पर) निजी रुचियों और विचारों पर आधारित). • From the above meanings, it is evident that factual is the correct antonym for the word fictitious. • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. 1a4:T91e, The correct answer is 'enquired'.
